reason: A DeepSeek Harness composer utility that rewrites non-empty text drafts with a flash model and fills the result back into the input without sending it.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框中使用闪速模型润色文本草稿，并将结果回填到输入框供用户继续编辑或发送。
summaries.en: Polishes text drafts in the DeepSeek Harness composer with a flash model and fills the result back into the input for further editing or sending.

capabilities: rewrites composer draft text using an LLM
writes the rewritten text back into the composer input
registers a composer button and slash command
sends draft content through the host command and model interfaces
